sources.compatibility: CLI/codebase mapper; no upstream SKILL.md in this snapshot. Use the toolkit codebase skill and current Graphify README.

sources.name: Strix
sources.compatibility: Security skills included in a separate profile; active testing remains explicit and authorization-scoped.

sources.name: ponytail
sources.compatibility: Skills included in a separate profile; its simplicity rules are summarized in root AGENTS.md.

sources.name: gstack
sources.compatibility: 65 upstream skills included; enable as its own profile because it overlaps with ECC and Superpowers and may require extra browser tooling.

sources.name: Firecrawl
